headline: Mexico's GDP grew 3.3% year-on-year in the third quarter: Inegi
summary: Mexico's economy grew 3.3% year on year in the third quarter, in line with initial estimates. Upward revisions to agriculture and services offset downward revisions to manufacturing.
why: GDP growth is the broadest gauge of an economy's health and shapes expectations for interest rates and corporate demand.
original_headline: El PIB de México creció 3.3% anual durante el tercer trimestre: Inegi
